title: Black Friday kitchen deals 2026: air fryers, coffee machines and mixers worth buying now
seoTitle: Black Friday Kitchen Deals 2026: Buy Now or Wait?
description: Which air fryers, Ninja gadgets, coffee machines and stand mixers are already at their lowest prices, which to wait for, and the prices worth paying.
intro:
**Several of the most popular kitchen gadgets are already at or below last year's Black Friday prices, led by the Ninja Dual Zone AF300UK at £119.99 on Amazon and the Nespresso Vertuo Pop from £49 at John Lewis.** Black Friday itself is on 27 November, and Amazon's Black Friday Week starts on 19 November.

Our advice: buy air fryers, Ninja SLUSHi and CREAMi and pod coffee machines now if the price matches our targets below. Wait on KitchenAid mixers, Sage espresso machines and Smeg, which are still above their recent lows. Prices checked on 16 November 2026.

deals.name: Ninja Foodi Dual Zone Air Fryer 7.6L (AF300UK)
deals.note: The two-drawer air fryer most families end up with. It sold for £128 at Ninja last Black Friday, so £119.99 already beats it. AO is £138 and Argos £149.99.

deals.name: Ninja Foodi 4-in-1 Dual Zone Air Fryer 7.6L (AF200UK)
deals.note: The simpler version of the AF300 with fewer cooking modes. Ignore Argos's £159.99 'was' price; £99.99 is what it cost last Black Friday, so it's a fair price rather than a record.

deals.name: Tower Vortx Vizion 11L Dual Basket Air Fryer (T17102)
deals.note: A big 11-litre dual basket with viewing windows for under £80. PriceSpy's lowest is £79 and Which? lists £79 as its six-month low, so this is as cheap as it gets.

deals.name: Ninja SLUSHi Frozen Drink Maker, Stone Gold (FS301UKSTGD)
deals.note: Makes slushies, frozen cocktails and milkshakes. Choose the Stone Gold colour: it's £199.99 against £309.99 for the standard colour at Argos, and last Black Friday's best was £247. See our [Ninja SLUSHi guide](/guides/ninja-slushi-deals-uk/).

deals.name: Ninja CREAMi Deluxe 10-in-1 Ice Cream Maker (NC501UKSTGD)
deals.note: Turns frozen bases into ice cream, sorbet and frozen yoghurt. £199.99 matches its three-month low on PriceSpy; Very is £209. More in our [Ninja CREAMi guide](/guides/ninja-creami-deals-uk/).

deals.name: Nespresso Vertuo Pop by De'Longhi (ENV90)
deals.note: A small, simple pod machine and an easy gift. It's £49 to £54 depending on colour; £49 matches the lowest price it has ever sold for.

deals.name: De'Longhi Magnifica Evo Bean-to-Cup Coffee Machine (ECAM290.22.B)
deals.note: Grinds fresh beans and has a milk frother, with no pods to buy. Other shops listed on PriceSpy charge £500-plus for this model. Check De'Longhi's own site too: sister models are £299.99 there.

body:
## Why now?

Kitchen appliances are one of the categories where early Black Friday prices are often the real ones. Retailers started cutting air fryers and Ninja gadgets in late October, and several have already hit the lowest prices tracked by PriceSpy and Which?. T3 notes that Currys' lowest prices often appear in the weeks before Black Friday rather than on the day. Amazon's Black Friday Week starts on Thursday 19 November and runs to Cyber Monday on 30 November, so expect a few more cuts then, but probably not big ones on the items already at their lows.

Home and kitchen is also where you get the most from price-matching. John Lewis matches 25 rival retailers, and Argos and Currys both run price guarantees that refund the difference if their own price falls later. That takes most of the risk out of buying now.

## Buy now

- **Two-drawer air fryers.** The Ninja AF300UK at £119.99 on Amazon beats last Black Friday's £128. The cheaper AF200UK is £99.99 at Argos, the same as last year. The Tower Vortx Vizion 11L is £79.99, matching its six-month low.
- **Ninja SLUSHi and CREAMi.** Both are £199.99 on Amazon in their Stone Gold versions. That's near the bottom of their recent ranges, and well below what the standard SLUSHi costs elsewhere.
- **Pod coffee machines.** The Nespresso Vertuo Pop from £49 at John Lewis matches its all-time low. They make good presents, and the cheapest colours sell out first.

## Wait for Black Friday

- **KitchenAid Artisan 4.8L (5KSM175).** The cheapest new price on PriceSpy is about £439, against a recent low of £389. Argos still charges £599. Expect it to fall further; see our [KitchenAid Black Friday guide](/guides/kitchenaid-black-friday-deals-2026/).
- **Sage Barista Express (BES875UK).** It's £499.94 at Argos, but TechRadar says that's about £50 above its record low.
- **Smeg kettles.** The KLF03 is £119 to £129, while PriceSpy's three-month low is £88. Our [Smeg Black Friday guide](/guides/smeg-black-friday-deals-2026/) has target prices.
- **Ninja Luxe Café.** Still £549 at Amazon and AO, so not discounted yet.
- **Philips 3000 NA342.** It's £159 at AO and Boots, against a six-month low of about £90 on Which?.

## Target prices

Use these as your 'good price' line. If it's at or below them, buy:

- Ninja AF300UK: **£120 to £128**
- Ninja AF200UK: **£99.99**
- Tower Vortx Vizion 11L: **£79**
- Ninja SLUSHi (Stone Gold): **under £200**
- Ninja CREAMi Deluxe: **£199.99**
- Nespresso Vertuo Pop: **£49 to £54**
- KitchenAid Artisan 4.8L: **under £400**

## How to choose

**Air fryers:** for two people, a single 5 to 6-litre basket is plenty. Families are better off with a dual-drawer model like the AF300, so mains and sides finish at the same time. Which? says air fryers typically fall 20% to 50% in sales, so anything claiming much more than 50% off probably has an inflated 'was' price. Our [air fryer Black Friday guide](/guides/air-fryer-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [Ninja Double Stack guide](/guides/ninja-double-stack-deals-uk/) go further.

**Coffee:** pods are the cheapest way in and the least fuss, but cost more per cup. Bean-to-cup machines like the Magnifica Evo cost more upfront and less per cup, and suit anyone drinking two or more coffees a day. Manual espresso machines such as the Sage Barista Express are for people who enjoy the process. Our [coffee machine Black Friday guide](/guides/coffee-machine-black-friday-deals-2026/) compares them.

**Mixers:** a KitchenAid lasts decades, but the Kenwood kMix does most of the same jobs for less. Only buy at a proper low.

## Check before you buy

Paste the product into PriceSpy (or CamelCamelCamel for Amazon) to see what it has really sold for. Buy from the retailer itself rather than a marketplace seller, and check the colour: Ninja's special-edition colours are often much cheaper than the standard ones. For everything else that's on this month, see [every Black Friday 2026 guide](/black-friday/).
